sourceTitle: See what 5 builders are making with Gemini 4 Carbon
originalTitle: See what 5 builders are making with Gemini 4 Carbon
author: Kimberly Fusaro

blocks.text: Gemini 4 Carbon was built for tasks that push the limits of a model’s intelligence, and builders are putting it to the test.
blocks.zh: Gemini4 Carbon 是为推进模型智能极限的任务而建造的,建造者们正在测试它。
blocks.en: Gemini 4 Carbon was built for tasks that push the limits of a model’s intelligence, and builders are putting it to the test.

blocks.text: Since we rolled out Carbon more broadly last week, we've seen the community lean into the model’s ability to explore thoroughly, reason deeply, and run extended verification loops. Find five impressive projects that demonstrate Carbon's capabilities below.
blocks.zh: 自从上周我们更广泛地推出碳之后,我们已经看到社区 倾斜到模型的能力 彻底探索,深究原因,并运行扩展验证循环。找到5个显示Carbon以下能力令人印象深刻的项目.
blocks.en: Since we rolled out Carbon more broadly last week, we've seen the community lean into the model’s ability to explore thoroughly, reason deeply, and run extended verification loops. Find five impressive projects that demonstrate Carbon's capabilities below.

blocks.text: Glitter Gal (@GlitterPixely on X) coded a meadow of 52,000 wildflowers and grass blades from scratch in CUDA and C++ with Carbon, synthesizing the wind to match every gust.
blocks.zh: Glitter Gal (@GlitterPixely on X) 从零开始在CUDA和C++中用Carbon编码了52,000个野花和草叶的草地,合成出风相接一一入.
blocks.en: Glitter Gal (@GlitterPixely on X) coded a meadow of 52,000 wildflowers and grass blades from scratch in CUDA and C++ with Carbon, synthesizing the wind to match every gust.

blocks.text: Developers can build with Carbon with the Gemini API paid tier in Google AI Studio and Android Studio. Google AI Ultra subscribers can try it in Google Antigravity, AI Studio, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search. And Gemini for business users can access it via the API or model drop down, Google Antigravity, or CodeMender.
blocks.zh: 开发者可以在Google AI Studio和Android Studio中用GeminiAPI付费分级来与Carbon一起构建.Google AI Ultra的用户可以在Google Antigravity中尝试它,AI工作室,Gemini应用程序,和搜索中的AI模式。Gemini可以让商业用户通过API或模型下降来访问它,谷歌反重力,或编剧。
blocks.en: Developers can build with Carbon with the Gemini API paid tier in Google AI Studio and Android Studio. Google AI Ultra subscribers can try it in Google Antigravity, AI Studio, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search. And Gemini for business users can access it via the API or model drop down, Google Antigravity, or CodeMender.
